CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

2. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

   D. Green, orange, and purple

5. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)

   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

13. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

----
